(Preliminary code for later)

``` r
# Estimate dispersion via an initial negative binomial fit.
nb_fit <- MASS::glm.nb(
  arrest ~ period * pct_black_latino + offset(log(crime)),
  data = arrest_over_crime
)

# Population-averaged negative binomial GEE, clustered by tract.
geepack::geeglm(
  arrest ~ period * pct_black_latino + offset(log(crime)),
  id = GEOID,
  family = MASS::negative.binomial(nb_fit$theta),
  corstr = "exchangeable",
  data = arrest_over_crime
)
```
